label_policy.review_rule: Actions, source-style cues, and glyph-support expectations are source-pixel review annotations. They are not masks, cleanup assets, replacements, translations, or implementation authorization.
label_policy.replacement_rule: replace is an intended candidate action only. A later policy decision, approved glyph support, and validated cleanup remain required before pixels may change.
label_policy.preservation_rule: preserve retains source pixels and forbids automatic cleanup and automatic replacement text. The retained OCR record remains usable as non-raster metadata.

ja-vertical-balloon.source_background: white balloon interior with black border
ja-vertical-balloon.notes: The allowed English layout remains the individual source balloon; vertical source writing must not force vertical English.

preserved-drawn-sfx.source_background: panel art, not a replacement plate
preserved-drawn-sfx.notes: Preserve the complete source effect and adjacent art; do not infer cleanup from its OCR box.

preserved-decorative-mark.stroke: integral or not distinguishable at this label resolution
preserved-decorative-mark.notes: This non-dialogue record is retained as metadata and cannot become a blank cleanup plate.
